title: A lightweight macOS app that gives you a clear, browsable view of your Codex and Claude Code skills

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Managing agent skills shouldn't feel like digging through folders. Codex Skill Manager makes it visual, fast, and native. It's a lightweight Mac OS app built with Swift UI that gives you a clear browsable view of your codecs and clawed code skills rendered straight from their skill.md files. Instead of juggling directories and zip files, you can explore local skills, preview documentation with inline references, and pull new skills directly from Clawdub, all in one face.
